name: Casual
description: Everyday play. Volumetric rays, true darkness, player shadows, ambient occlusion and the Luma sky, with dust and fireflies in the air and a light grade on top.

name: Comp
description: Stripped for competitive play. Almost everything off - just a touch of colour grading and a few dust motes, so nothing moves that you did not expect.

name: Movie
description: Cinematic. Film look, drama, letterbox bars, vignette and grain over volumetric rays and the Luma sky, graded warm.

name: Horror
description: Cold and close. Heavy film grain, chromatic aberration, drama and atmospheric haze, with the lighting effects switched off so the dark stays dark.

name: Chronos
description: Night, turned up. Ray-traced lighting, a burning sun, haze, lens flare and the full set of creatures - birds, butterflies and bees.
